The standalone program constructs and exactly verifies Fv=e and Fw=v, yielding moments (1,1),(4,24),(9,145),(16,560), with variances 0,8,64,304. Positive monotone survival and invertible reachable F exclude dark surviving mass. First-step renewal gives M(r)=(1-r)(1-f(1-r))/(r f(1-r)), derivative (mean squared minus mean minus variance)/2, and exact slopes 0,2,4,-32. The same rational finite computation proves the classical comparison.
